bundle.shortDescription: Free, lightweight, no-nonsense MongoDB and PostgreSQL client
bundle.longDescription: Mongo Bongo is a free and open-source MongoDB and PostgreSQL desktop client. Browse data in table or document form, edit documents field by field, build aggregation pipelines, inspect indexes and schema, and run real shell statements - with credentials encrypted in your OS keychain and production connections opening read-only.
